point-nine._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across Point Nine's surfaces (the 2026 Webflow list, the Getro job board at jobs.pointnine.com, the archived pointninecap.com and pointnine.com listings, Form D issuer names) and its rebrands. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed. The builder's prefix rule does NOT merge the board's suffixed names here, because both renderings sit in the one site layer and count as co-listed; each pair is therefore an explicit entry below, with the published name pinned.

merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'xChange' (container-xchange.com, Hamburg), the job board 'Container xChange' with the same domain; the register names it xChange Solutions GmbH
one company: Podcastle (podcastle.ai, Yerevan) rebranded as Async (async.com); the job board card still reads 'Podcastle' and describes 'Async (formerly Podcastle)'
one company: Vital (tryvital.io) renamed Junction (junction.com); the job board card reads 'Vital' and describes 'Junction (formerly VITAL)'

one position: TIER Mobility merged with Dott in 2024 and the combined company trades as Dott (ridedott.com); the site renders the Point Nine investment as 'Tier', the job board lists the combined company as 'Dott'; one company: the CMS renders 'Tier Mobility' (PNC IV)

merges.name: AMMP
merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'AMMP', the job board 'AMMP Technologies' (ammp.io)

merges.name: Detail
merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'Detail', the job board 'Detail Technologies' (detail.co)

merges.name: Factorial
merges.reason: one company: the job board's 'Factorial HR' card (factorialhr.de, carrying a Munich restaurant's description, a Getro data error) is Factorial's German domain; the site renders 'Factorial'

merges.name: Goodays
merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'Goodays', the job board 'Goodays (Ex-Critizr)' (goodays.co; formerly Critizr); one company: Critizr renamed Goodays (the job board: 'Goodays (Ex-Critizr)'); the CMS renders 'Critizr' (PNC III, Lille)

merges.name: Kisi
merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'KISI', the job board 'Kisi Security' (getkisi.com); published as 'Kisi', the brand in normal capitalization (COLLECTION.md s8 name rule, Erik 2026-09-24: KISI is a word, not a letter acronym)

merges.name: Soda
merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'Soda', the job board 'Soda Data' (soda.io)

merges.name: rerun
merges.reason: one company: the site renders 'rerun', the job board 'Rerun.io' (rerun.io)
one company: Kreditech was founded as Kredito in 2012; the 2013 pointninecap.com list renders 'Kredito' (big-data credit scoring and loans), the CMS and the live site 'Kreditech'

one company: WIRKAUFENS (wirkaufens.de, trade-in for used electronics) was asgoodasnew electronics GmbH's buying brand; the 2012-2015 list renders it WIRKAUFENS from 2011, the register names Fund I on asgoodasnew's shareholder list

one position: the fund entered Lieferheld's EUR 800k seed in 2010 and Delivery Hero's seed in 2011; Lieferheld and Delivery Hero merged in 2012 (the firm's own post, 2017-06-30); the old list renders 'Lieferheld ... Acquired by DeliveryHero'
one company: myGengo renamed Gengo
one company: Positionly renamed Unamo (the site's own card)
one company: ShiftPlanning renamed Humanity (the site's own card)
one company: SponsorPay renamed Fyber (the firm's own post, 2014-10-31)
one company: ePetWorld GmbH ran the Hundeland pet-food shop; the 2013-2015 list renders 'ePetWorld' (online shop for pet food, added 2012-07), the CMS and the live site 'Hundeland' (PNC II)
one company: the CMS renders 'LIFT Aircraft' (PNC IV / IV), the live site 'LIFT'
one company: the old list and the CMS misspell it 'Combatant Gentlement'
one company: the old list misspells it 'Contenful'
one company: the CMS renders 'Mister Spex', the live site 'MisterSpex'

one company: zerolens GmbH (Vienna) whose product ran as Zerolens (2021-2022), Colorful Studio (2023) and Mokker.ai (2024 on); Point Nine invested Sept 2020 (nordic9.com); the register names Fund V's participation in zerolens GmbH
one company: Hipclub (Russian online travel club, on the 2012-2015 list) renamed Hipway (the 2021-2023 list, RIP)
merges.name: Hipway
